physDesc.physMedium: 1 bifolio and 1 folio. Written in ink. Paper: 20 staves. With minor cancellations. In upper right-hand corner of the first music page Gade has written in blue crayon: "Finale til Novelletter / ikke benyttet." At the end of the music dated: "Fine. / 6. August 1853 and Gade's musical signature."
